thesis: The page is a scale-ticket docket: every section is a perforated stub that records what left the house, where it went, and at what weight, so trust is built by paperwork rather than promises.

signature.name: Perforated Weigh Ticket
signature.summary: A dashed-left-border ticket stub with carbon-teal offset copy, mono ticket number, date, load type and weight; accumulates tonnage in header via --sw-p.

palette.family: Scale-Ticket Buff + Carbon Teal + Stamp Red

motion.intro: Ticket feeds from top slot; DM Mono digits print sequentially (≤1.2s, skippable).
stories: stack: ticket stubs slide up into margin as sections enter
count: header tonnage total counts up via data-count
motion.hover: Stub lifts 2px and carbon-teal offset shifts right 4px via translateX.
